extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Lines and shapes on dot grid — straight lines (ruler lines, no curves), curved lines (bent or rounded). On a dot grid, connect dots to make straight lines and shapes. (2) Tangram — a tangram is a Chinese puzzle with 7 pieces: 2 large triangles, 1 medium triangle, 2 small triangles, 1 square, 1 parallelogram. The 7 pieces can be arranged to make many shapes (animals, people, objects). (3) Comparing shapes by properties — sides (edges) and corners (vertices). Triangle: 3 sides, 3 corners. Square: 4 equal sides, 4 right-angle corners. Rectangle: 4 sides (2 pairs equal), 4 right-angle corners. Pentagon: 5 sides, 5 corners. Hexagon: 6 sides, 6 corners. Circle: 0 sides, 0 corners (curved all around). (4) Tessellation — tessellation (tiling) means covering a flat surface with shapes that fit together without gaps or overlaps. Shapes that tile: square, rectangle, triangle, hexagon (like honeycomb). Shapes that do NOT tile: circle (leaves gaps), oval, some pentagons. (5) Shapes that tile vs don't tile — squares tile perfectly (like floor tiles), triangles tile (alternate up and down), hexagons tile (like beehive), circles cannot tile (they leave curved gaps between them). Misconceptions: 'a square and rectangle are the same' (square has 4 EQUAL sides, rectangle has 2 pairs of equal sides — all squares are rectangles but not all rectangles are squares), 'a circle has 1 side' (a circle has 0 sides and 0 corners — it is a continuous curve), 'all shapes can tile' (circles and ovals cannot tile because they leave gaps), 'a triangle cannot tile' (triangles CAN tile by alternating up and down), 'tangram has 5 pieces' (tangram has 7 pieces: 2 large triangles, 1 medium triangle, 2 small triangles, 1 square, 1 parallelogram). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function ShapesTessellationGame), NOT export default. Export interface ShapesTessellationGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
